notes:
Follow-up release fixing four rebrand misses identified in the v1.0.30 audit, the blurry-app-icon report, a silently-broken telemetry opt-in path that has been dead since v1.0.19, the hardcoded admin password seeded by `migrate.py`, and a legacy autorun registry key the v1.0.30 uninstaller did not remove. No functional changes for the trading engine.

This is a normal point release - both v1.0.30 and v1.0.31 share the `com.asasystems.terminal` Tauri identifier, so v1.0.30 users update via the in-app updater the same way every other point release lands. No manual install required.

### Fixes

- **Admin docs panel.** `dashboard.html` Developer Documentation section showed a stale "TradeSpace/" folder header. Now reads "ASA Terminal/".
- **Terms of Service.** The solicitor-review `{{DECISION:}}` flag at line 57 of `legal/terms-of-service.md` mentioned "TRADESPACE" inside its body. Replaced with "ASA TRADING SYSTEMS LTD" while preserving the `{{DECISION:}}` markers (those are intentional review flags, not template artefacts).
- **Internal report generator.** `tools/generate_report.py` had a stale "10 THE TRADESPACE DIFFERENCE" section comment. Updated to match the actual section title that gets rendered.
- **Telemetry opt-in (since v1.0.19).** `_telemetry_opted_in()` in `server.py` was reading `%APPDATA%/io.tradespace.app/settings.json`, but the tray writes to `%APPDATA%/TradeSpace/app-settings.json`. The function returned False unconditionally for every user, so even users who toggled "Send anonymous crash reports" ON had Sentry silently disabled. Now reads the new `%APPDATA%/com.asasystems.terminal/app-settings.json` first, falls back to the legacy `%APPDATA%/TradeSpace/app-settings.json` for migrated users so neither location is missed.

### Icon (sharpness fix)

The previous `icon.ico` only embedded 16/32/48/64/256 sub-images. Windows scaled the 32x32 to 96px for shortcut icons, which produced a visibly blurry result on the desktop and Start menu. Rebuilt with the full Microsoft-recommended set: 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128, 256.

At small sizes the wordmark is unreadable (the A's collapse into noise), so 16/24/32/48 now use a glyph-only mark - the green folded "S" element from `branding/png/wordmark-master.png`, centred on the same charcoal rounded square. 64/128/256 keep the full ASA wordmark. Generated by `scripts/build_icon.py` using Pillow LANCZOS resampling at each native size (no upscaling cascades).

### Security

- **Hardcoded admin password removed.** `migrate.py` previously seeded the migrated admin user with `changeme123`. v1.0.31 reads `ASA_ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD` from the environment if set; otherwise generates a 16-char URL-safe random password via `secrets.token_urlsafe(12)` and prints it ONCE to stdout with a "ROTATE THIS IMMEDIATELY" warning. The generated password is never written to a log file. For users who already migrated on v1.0.x and still have `changeme123` set, migration now prints an explicit warning at boot reminding them to rotate via the dashboard (admin email is `admin@asaterminal.local`).

### Cleanup

- **Legacy HKCU autorun key.** The v1.0.29 installer wrote `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\TradeSpace`. The v1.0.30 NSIS uninstaller did not recognise that name, so the orphan entry persisted and tried to launch a missing executable on every login for v1.0.x->v1.0.30 migrators. NSIS POSTINSTALL hook in `tray-app/src-tauri/windows/hooks.nsh` now deletes the legacy `TradeSpace` value once on install of v1.0.31. Idempotent - silently no-ops if the key is already gone.
